rationale: User: 4K 120dpi block cursor has a 1px gap after the previous glyph; 96dpi and wezterm-gui do not. Cursor bg was round(col*cell_w)+round(cell_w); at 1.25 that can skip a pixel before the next cell. Width is now round((col+n)*cell_w)-round(col*cell_w). Same snap lesson as 025. Do not ceil cell_w (would change dest size).
